summary: Implement cloud sync between CyberSchedule RN app and api.epoch0.org for single-user rating data. Adds tombstone-based soft delete, a Bearer-authed API client, a repository wrapper, a debounced sync scheduler with exponential backoff retry, settings UI for token management, and a delete entry in the rating detail modal. App-side always uses default LWW (no expected_updated_at), all timestamps at millisecond ISO precision.

phases.name: Tombstone schema + local soft delete
phases.description: Add optional deleted_at field to TimeSlotRating schema. Refactor LocalRatingRepository so remove(id) writes a tombstone (save with deleted_at=now, updated_at=now, other fields preserved) instead of physically deleting. list() filters out records where deleted_at != null; get(id) returns null for soft-deleted records; listPendingSync() continues to return tombstones (synced_at == null) so they push. Remove on an already-soft-deleted record is a no-op. Ensure all new timestamps use new Date().toISOString() (millisecond precision); audit existing code for any .slice(0,19) or second-precision timestamp construction and fix.

LocalRatingRepository.remove writes tombstone preserving rating/efficiency/mood/etc; does not physically delete
LocalRatingRepository.list() excludes records with deleted_at != null
LocalRatingRepository.get(id) returns null for soft-deleted records
LocalRatingRepository.listPendingSync() includes tombstones whose synced_at is null
Calling remove on an already-soft-deleted record is a no-op (no double-tombstone, no throw)
All timestamps generated anywhere in the rating feature are millisecond-precision ISO (toISOString); no .slice(0,19) remnants
Existing rating UI (useRatings, RatingHistoryList) still works unchanged and does not see tombstones

Existing local repository tests still pass after refactor

phases.name: CloudRatingApiClient + sync types
phases.description: Create src/features/rating/sync/ module with sync-state.ts (SyncStatus union type and SyncStateEmitter) and api-client.ts exposing CloudRatingApiClient with sync() and list() methods. Bearer auth via injected getToken callback (fetched per request, not cached). 10s request timeout. Non-2xx throws SyncError with statusCode; partial-success response.errors is not treated as failure. Never send expected_updated_at on outgoing records. baseUrl default https://api.epoch0.org, injectable for tests.

CloudRatingApiClient.sync({records, since}) POSTs to /v1/ratings/sync with Authorization: Bearer <token>
CloudRatingApiClient.list(since) GETs /v1/ratings?since=<ISO>
Token fetched via getToken() on every request (not cached)
Outgoing record payload never contains expected_updated_at field

Non-2xx responses throw SyncError carrying statusCode
Response body errors[] array is returned to caller as partial success, not thrown
baseUrl is injectable via constructor; default constant https://api.epoch0.org

phases.name: SyncingRatingRepository wrapper
phases.description: Create src/features/rating/sync/syncing-repository.ts implementing RatingRepository by delegating to an injected local repository and notifying an injected scheduler on every write. save(r) and remove(id) forward to local then call scheduler.notifyLocalChange(). list/get/listPendingSync/markSynced pass through unchanged. No direct network calls here; all sync is scheduler-driven.
acceptance: SyncingRatingRepository implements the same RatingRepository interface as LocalRatingRepository
save() calls local.save then scheduler.notifyLocalChange in order
remove() calls local.remove (which now tombstones) then scheduler.notifyLocalChange
list / get / listPendingSync / markSynced forward to local untouched
No network or fetch calls occur inside SyncingRatingRepository itself
tests: save invokes local.save with same record and then scheduler.notifyLocalChange exactly once
remove invokes local.remove and then scheduler.notifyLocalChange exactly once
list returns whatever local.list returns (pass-through)
get returns null when local.get returns null (tombstoned)
markSynced delegates to local.markSynced with same args

phases.name: SyncScheduler singleton
phases.description: Create src/features/rating/sync/sync-scheduler.ts implementing a singleton scheduler. API: start, stop, notifyLocalChange (5s debounce), pullNow (immediate, no debounce), getStatus, onStatusChange. doSync flow: emit syncing → collect pending via listPendingSync → compute since = max local updated_at → call api.sync → LWW-merge returned records into local → markSynced on accepted records using server_time → emit idle. Exponential backoff for network/5xx/timeout: 5s, 30s, 2m, 5m, 5m... capped at 5min, unlimited retries. 401/403: emit error with token invalid message, do NOT auto-retry, wait for explicit start()/notifyLocalChange. Partial rejected records: log, no backoff, proceed normally. A new notifyLocalChange during backoff resets backoff and schedules 5s debounce. Status messages follow spec wording including retry countdowns.
acceptance: getSyncScheduler() returns the same instance across calls
start() initializes scheduler; calling when already started is a no-op
stop() clears debounce timers, retry timers, and pending state
notifyLocalChange() debounces 5s; rapid calls only fire one doSync
pullNow() fires immediately without debounce

markSynced is called for every pushed record that was not in response.errors[]
Records returned from server are merged into local with LWW by updated_at (newer wins)
Tombstones pulled from server upsert locally and are hidden by list() automatically
Network/5xx/timeout failure schedules retry using 5s, 30s, 2m, 5m, 5m... capped at 5min; unlimited attempts
401/403 failure emits error with token-invalid message and does NOT schedule auto-retry
A notifyLocalChange during backoff cancels backoff and restarts 5s debounce
getStatus and onStatusChange reflect idle/syncing/error/unconfigured transitions; unsubscribe returned from onStatusChange works
Error status messages match spec copy including retry countdown formatting

5s debounce collapses multiple notifyLocalChange calls into one doSync (fake timers)

Successful doSync emits syncing → idle and calls markSynced for each applied record using server_time

onStatusChange subscriber receives updates; unsubscribe stops further callbacks

phases.name: Settings cloud-sync section + delete UI in detail modal
phases.description: Settings page: add a 云端同步 section above 数据管理 / 导出打分数据. Use useTheme for colors and lucide-react-native Cloud icon. Includes secureTextEntry TextInput for token, save button (persists to AsyncStorage key cs-rn:sync-token, then scheduler.start() + scheduler.pullNow()), live status row subscribed to scheduler.getStatus() re-rendered every 30s for relative time, and a debug 立即同步 button. Token clear removes the AsyncStorage key. Status copy matches spec. Rating history detail modal: add a 删除 button at bottom in destructive/danger style (reuse existing 清除所有数据 style or low-saturation primary), Alert.alert two-step confirm with copy 删除这条打分？ / 删除后本地列表和云端都不再显示，可通过同步协议恢复。, destructive confirm invokes ratings.service.remove(id), closes modal, refreshes list. No swipe-to-delete or long-press menu in the list.

phases.name: Wire scheduler into app lifecycle + RatingServiceProvider
phases.description: RatingServiceProvider constructs LocalRatingRepository, then getSyncScheduler({local, apiClient}), then SyncingRatingRepository wrapping both, and passes the wrapper to createRatingsService. On app boot, if token exists in AsyncStorage, call scheduler.start(). Subscribe to AppState 'active' transitions and call scheduler.pullNow(). Ensure apiClient.getToken reads AsyncStorage on each call so token updates from Settings take effect without reinit.
acceptance: RatingServiceProvider uses SyncingRatingRepository wrapping LocalRatingRepository

App continues to work when offline / token missing (no crashes, status reflects state)
